title: Stalk of a presheaf of abelian groups on a basis
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space and $\mathcal B$ a set of open subsets of $X$ which is a basis of the topology and satisfies $U\cap V\in\mathcal B$ for $U,V\in\mathcal B$. Let $F$ be a presheaf of abelian groups on $\mathcal B$: abelian groups $F(U)$ for $U\in\mathcal B$ and homomorphisms $r_{U,V}:F(U)\to F(V)$ for $V\subseteq U$ in $\mathcal B$ with $r_{U,U}=\mathrm{id}$, $r_{V,W}r_{U,V}=r_{U,W}$ (a functor $\mathcal B^{op}\to\mathbf{Ab}$, $\mathcal B$ ordered by inclusion). For $x\in X$ let $\mathcal B_x=\{U\in\mathcal B:x\in U\}$, a directed set under reverse inclusion ($U\cap V\in\mathcal B_x$ for $U,V\in\mathcal B_x$; nonempty since $\mathcal B$ is a basis and $x\in X$ open). The *stalk* of $F$ at $x$ is the colimit $F_x=\operatorname{colim}_{U\in\mathcal B_x}F(U)$ in the category of abelian groups of the restriction of $F$ to $\mathcal B_x^{op}$, with its colimit maps $\sigma\mapsto\sigma_x=(U,\sigma)_x:F(U)\to F_x$ (the *germ* maps), which are homomorphisms with $(r_{U,V}\sigma)_x=\sigma_x$ for $x\in V\subseteq U$ in $\mathcal B$.

source.place: Section 009H (label section-bases), after Definition 009I (label definition-presheaf-basis): F_x = colim_{U in B, x in U} F(U), a directed colimit; and after Definition 009P (label definition-sheaf-structures-basis) for values in an algebraic structure (the underlying set of F_x is the stalk of the underlying presheaf of sets)
